why: The one Chicago food souvenir that travels in a bag and photographs while you walk. Sweet and salty in the same handful is the whole trick, and it is why the clip format keeps repeating.
why_zh: 芝加哥最好带走的一样吃的，装袋就能拎着走，边走边拍也顺手。一把里甜的咸的一起吃是它的全部卖点，短视频翻来覆去拍的也就是这个。
tip: Go to 625 N Michigan Ave specifically. The line looks long but moves fast.
tip_zh: 只认 625 N Michigan Ave 这家。队伍看着长，其实走得很快。
caveat: Several nearby Michigan Ave-area Garrett storefronts are permanently closed — 670 N Michigan and 4 E Madison both show as CLOSED on Yelp. An old guide or stale address will send you to a shuttered door a block away.
caveat_zh: 密歇根大街一带有好几家 Garrett 已经永久关门，670 N Michigan 和 4 E Madison 在 Yelp 上都标着 CLOSED。照着老攻略上的地址走，很可能到了门口发现是关的，就差一个街区。

name: Zmzm Sweets
address: 10511 S Harlem Ave, Chicago Ridge, IL 60415
rating_note: aggregate roughly 3.9-4.0 stars across 1,600+ cross-platform reviews; exact current Yelp count not independently pulled (403 block), but multiple secondary sources converge near 4.0
per_person: 人均 $12-25（水果造型甜点 $9.99 一个）
signature: 3D fruit-shaped pastries at $9.99 each — mango, strawberry, lemon, passionfruit, dragon fruit — plus knafeh.
signature_zh: 3D 水果造型甜点，$9.99 一个，芒果、草莓、柠檬、百香果、火龙果都有，还有卡纳法 knafeh。
why: They look like actual fruit until you cut one open and the cream comes out. That reveal is the entire video, and unlike most viral desserts this one is a real Middle Eastern shop with real hours, not a pop-up.
why_zh: 做得跟真水果一模一样，切开才流出内馅，短视频拍的就是这一刀。跟很多昙花一现的网红甜品不同，它是一家正经的中东甜品店，有固定营业时间，不是快闪。
tip: Open late — until midnight most nights, 1am Friday and Saturday.
tip_zh: 开得很晚，平时到凌晨 12 点，周五周六到凌晨 1 点，宵夜时段也能去。

name: Goddess and the Baker
name_zh: Goddess and the Baker 彩虹蛋糕
neighborhood: Loop (33 S Wabash flagship, near Millennium Park)
neighborhood_zh: 市中心 Loop（33 S Wabash 旗舰店，靠近千禧公园）
address: 33 S Wabash Ave, Chicago, IL 60603
rating_note: Google about 4.3; Tripadvisor about 4/5 (#83 of 5,231 Chicago restaurants, 508 reviews); Yelp listing shows 1,799 reviews, exact star figure not independently confirmed (403 block)
per_person: 人均 $12-20（一块蛋糕加一杯咖啡）
signature: The rainbow cake, sold by the slice.
signature_zh: 招牌彩虹蛋糕，按块卖。
why: A color-blocked slice that photographs without any styling, from a standing menu rather than a limited drop — you can plan around it. The 33 S Wabash location puts it a short walk from Millennium Park.
why_zh: 切面色块分明，不用摆盘就出片，而且是常驻菜单不是限定款，行程里可以放心排。33 S Wabash 这家离千禧公园很近，看完「豆子」顺路就能过去。
tip: Daytime only — the flagship closes at 4pm on weekdays and 3pm on Sunday. Walk-in, no reservations.
tip_zh: 只做白天生意，工作日 16:00 关门，周日 15:00 就打烊，晚上去会扑空。不接受订位，直接进去点。

name: La Boulangerie & Co
name_zh: La Boulangerie & Co（可颂饼干 Crookie）
address: 3129 W Logan Blvd, Chicago, IL 60647
rating_note: Yelp: 3.9 stars, 155 reviews; a Chamber of Commerce aggregator separately shows 4.5 across 474 reviews — the two do not reconcile
per_person: 人均 $10-18（一个 crookie 加一杯咖啡）
signature: The crookie — cookie dough baked into a croissant.
signature_zh: Crookie：可颂里裹进曲奇面团一起烤。
why: Chicago's entry in the croissant-hybrid wave that started in Paris, and it is an actual standing menu item here rather than a one-week stunt. Baked in batches, so the cross-section is the shot.
why_zh: 从巴黎火起来的可颂混种，芝加哥这家是常驻菜单，不是搞一个星期就撤的噱头。一炉一炉现烤，掰开的横截面就是大家拍的那一下。
tip: Go in the morning. Items are baked in batches and afternoons are picked over. Closes at 2:30pm daily.
tip_zh: 上午去。一炉一炉烤，下午基本挑不到什么了，而且每天 14:30 就关门。
caveat: Yelp has it at 3.9 across 155 reviews, under the 4.0 bar, while a Chamber of Commerce aggregator shows 4.5 across 474 — the two numbers do not agree and neither was independently confirmed. Separately, do not confuse it with the unrelated 'La Boulangerie' at 2569 N Milwaukee Ave, which closed permanently in 2013 and still surfaces in search.
caveat_zh: Yelp 上 3.9 分 155 条评价，没到 4 分线；另一个商会聚合站却显示 4.5 分 474 条，两个数字对不上，也都没能直接核实，别把它当成稳赢的店。另外别导航错：2569 N Milwaukee Ave 那家同名的 La Boulangerie 早在 2013 年就永久关门了，搜索里还会跳出来。

name: Fat Peach Bakery
name_zh: Fat Peach Bakery 草莓牛奶可颂
address: 2907 S Archer Ave, Chicago, IL 60608
closed_days: closed Mon-Wed; open Thu-Sun only, 9am-2pm (some posts say Fri-Sun, which is wrong by a day)
rating_note: Yelp: 78 reviews; exact star rating not found — treat as unverified
signature: The strawberry milk croissant.
signature_zh: 草莓牛奶可颂。
why: Small-batch and four days a week, so it genuinely sells out rather than performing scarcity. The stuffed-croissant cross-section does the work on camera.
why_zh: 小批量出品，一周只开四天，是真的会卖完，不是营造饥饿感。夹馅可颂掰开的断面很出片，短视频拍的就是这个。
tip: Open Thursday to Sunday, 9am-2pm. The line starts forming 30-plus minutes before opening and items sell out fast — arrive early or don't bother.
tip_zh: 周四到周日 9:00-14:00，周一到周三不开门。开门前半小时就开始排队，热门品项很快售罄，要么早到，要么别去。

name: Daeji Dough Company
address: 1360 W Belmont Ave, Chicago, IL 60657
closed_days: check hours — items typically sell out by 11am
rating_note: Yelp: 52 reviews; exact star rating not found — quoted reviews are consistently positive
signature: The tteokbokki croissant — a seaweed croissant filled with Korean rice cake, chewy inside and crunchy outside.
signature_zh: 炒年糕可颂：海苔可颂里塞韩式年糕，外面脆、里面糯。
why: A savory Korean-French mashup that Axios and WTTW both covered, so the buzz is not creator-only. Chewy rice cake inside a laminated pastry is a texture combination you will not find at home.
why_zh: 韩式咸口和法式起酥的组合，Axios 和 WTTW 都报道过，不是只有博主在推。年糕的糯配上可颂的酥，是国内基本吃不到的口感组合，值得专门跑一趟。
tip: Opened fall 2025 and still busy — most items are gone by about 11am, so go early. The bulgogi-mushroom focaccia is worth adding.
tip_zh: 2025 年秋天新开，热度还在，基本 11 点前就卖完了，想吃早点去。牛肉蘑菇佛卡夏也顺手带一个。

name: Do-Rite Donuts
neighborhood: Multiple locations (West Loop flagship, Erie St, Wacker Dr, Wrigleyville, Streeterville)
neighborhood_zh: 多家分店（West Loop 旗舰店、Erie 街、Wacker 大道、Wrigleyville、Streeterville）
address: multiple — e.g. 233 E Erie St, Chicago, IL 60611
closed_days: none — multiple locations, check the specific store's hours
rating_note: Erie St: 4.6 stars, 3,669 reviews; Streeterville: 4.7, 266 reviews; Willis Tower (Tripadvisor): 4.8/5
per_person: 人均 $5-15（一两个甜甜圈加咖啡）
signature: Seasonal specialty donuts — the pistachio and pumpkin versions get named most often.
signature_zh: 季节限定甜甜圈，开心果和南瓜这两款被点名最多。
why: No single viral clip carries it, but the ratings do the talking: 4.6 to 4.8 across locations on thousands of reviews. This is the rare place that over-delivers relative to its online footprint. The fried chicken sandwich on a donut is now a draw too.
why_zh: 没有哪条爆款视频专门捧它，但评分实打实：各分店 4.6 到 4.8，光 Erie 街店就 3,669 条评价。属于网上声量小、实际水准高的那一类，反过来最不容易踩雷。现在炸鸡甜甜圈三明治也成了招牌。
tip: Multiple locations, so pick the one on your route rather than making a trip — check that store's hours before going.
tip_zh: 分店多，按行程顺路挑一家就行，不用专门跑。去之前查一下那家店当天的营业时间，各店不一样。

name: Bing Chillin' Bites (at Gangnam Market)
name_zh: Bing Chillin' Bites 冻干水果冰淇淋（Gangnam Market 内）
address: freezer section of Gangnam Market, Chicago (exact market address not independently confirmed)
closed_days: follows Gangnam Market's own hours — no separate schedule
rating_note: not found — no venue-level rating exists, this is not a sit-down location
signature: Crunchy freeze-dried-style ice cream bites made with real fruit.
signature_zh: 冻干口感的水果冰淇淋小方块，用的是真水果。
why: A packaged snack with an unusual texture that got direct promotion through creator meet-and-greets at the market. Cheap, and it survives a walk around the store.
why_zh: 口感特别的一包冷冻零食，靠博主在超市搞见面会推起来的。便宜，逛超市的时候顺手买，拿在手里逛一圈也不会化。
tip: Buy it while you are already doing a Korean grocery run — check the freezer section.
tip_zh: 逛韩国超市顺手拿一包就行，在冷冻柜里找。
caveat: This is a packaged grocery-freezer product, not a dessert destination. It has no address, hours, seating or rating of its own — a good add-on if you are already at the market, not worth a dedicated trip.
caveat_zh: 这不是一家店，是超市冷冻柜里的一包零食，没有自己的地址、营业时间、座位和评分。已经在那家超市的话顺手买，别把它当成一个甜品打卡点专门跑一趟。
